role: Director of Comprehensive Planning, State of New Hampshire
summary: Alexander M. Taft, Director of Comprehensive Planning for the State of New Hampshire, concurs with the Draft Environmental Statement as written and offers no additional comments of his own. He notes that as the designated State Clearinghouse under OMB Circular A-95, he distributed the statement to other interested state agencies and is enclosing their responses. His letter is brief and supportive, deferring substantive commentary to the enclosed agency responses.

statement.text:
STATE OF NEW HAMPSHIRE
CONCORD 03301
OFFICE OF GOVERNOR
DIRECTOR OF COMPREHENSIVE PLANNING
July 13, 1972
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation United States Department of the Interior Washington, D.C. 20240
Dear Mr. Hofe:
The Draft Environmental Statement relative to the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands has been reviewed by this office, and we concur with the Statement as written and have no additional comments.
As the designated State Clearinghouse under the provisions of Circular A-95, we distributed the Statement to other interested state agencies for their review. Enclosed are copies of the responses and comments we have received.
Sincerely,
Alexander M. Taft
